author: ruralhackers
caption: English🩵 Today we celebrate a milestone in our CERV journey: our local event brought together 80 people in the rural area to talk about real community challenges and opportunities. During the event, we conducted interviews on data gaps in 3 villages: Gaxate, Vilán and Anceu, welcomed 8 rural innovation projects from Galicia, and opened a dialogue on public policy with the visit of the local corporation of Ponte Caldelas Municipality. For us, this is what CERV is about: Citizens, Equality, Rights and Values becoming real through participation, democracy, and local action. Europe is not only in Brussels. Europe is also in our villages, in community halls, in shared conversations, and in people building the future together from the ground up. 👥 Galego🩵 Hoxe celebramos un fito do noso camiño en CERV: o noso evento local reuniu a 80 persoas no rural para falar de retos e oportunidades reais das comunidades. Durante o evento fixemos entrevistas sobre data gaps en 3 aldeas: Gaxate, Vilán e Anceu, convidamos a 8 proxectos de innovación rural de Galicia, e abrimos diálogo sobre políticas públicas coa visita da corporación municipal do Concello de Ponte Caldelas. Para nós, isto é o que significa CERV: Cidadanía, Igualdade, Dereitos e Valores convertidos en participación real, democracia e acción local. Europa non está só en Bruxelas. Europa tamén está nas aldeas nas casas do pobo, nas conversas compartidas e na xente que constrúe futuro desde o territorio.👥 Grazas de ❤️ @eyre.foto @suidolab @meleirasdosuido @muimenta.viva @vazquezaliciavazquez @pangea.aperta @do_picho @andresdiazsobral #CERV #EUProjects #RuralInnovation #DataDemocracy #Galicia RuralCommunities CitizensParticipation".

caption: ¡Ola! ✨ Querémosvos convidar a gozar dunn día marabilloso en Anceu. Todo o que saia destas conversas vainos servir para hackear eses retos despois desde Rural Hackers. 🌀 Proxectos que están transformando Galiza. A media mañá presentámosvos un feixe de proxectos que están pasando cousas moi interesantes no territorio — sitios aos que vos podedes sumar desde mil oportunidades distintas. 🥘 Paella 🌳Para rematar, baño de bosque para soltar o corpo e a cabeza. author: ruralhackers
caption: In @ruralhackers we’re kicking off YRUX, a journey that brings together young people from rural and urban territories to learn from each other, grow in community, and take action. Over the next two years, we’ll be working with youth from Spain, Italy, Türkiye and Latvia to explore how place shapes identity and how young people can lead change no matter where they’re from. Together, we will: ✨ Build youth groups capable of activating their communities ✨ Explore new ways of leading from the collective ✨ Research how rural + urban spaces connect and influence each other ✨ Create exchanges that move ideas, people, and practices across borders YRUX is a space to listen deeply. To bring the voices of young people to the center. To prototype new ways of connecting territories that have often been seen as separate. 🏙️🏡 Partners @legambiente_trani @pixie.academy @societycreativeideas @espacio.geranios @ruralhackers #YRUX #YouthForChange #ErasmusPlus #YouthEmpowerment #RuralYouth #UrbanYouth #BeTheVoice".

author: ruralhackers
caption: Rural Hackers BY ELEVEN YELLOW Residencies NOW OPEN FOR CANDIDATES MAY 15 - JUN 15 BUILD SOMETHING BOLD AI-ART RESIDENCIES, VIDEO, IMAGE, PROGRAMMING... (maybe something innovative? we do not really care whats about, we need brave people with us) An opportunity for builders, thinkers, and experimenters who want time, space, and the right environment to push an idea forward. No rigid schedules, no forced outcomes. Just you, your vision, and a community of Rural Hackers pushing the boundaries of technology and creativity. For a few weeks, you'll step away from the noise and dive into deep work—prototyping, experimenting, and turning ideas into reality. This is not about producing content for a client or meeting deadlines imposed by a boardroom; it’s about unrestricted creative flow, driven by curiosity, technical exploration, and a passion for breaking new ground. At Rural Hackers, we understand that true innovation doesn’t happen inside structured frameworks—it happens when people get their hands dirty, hack systems, and challenge the status quo. Whether you're a digital artist, coder, video creator, or AI tinkerer, or a cool person this is a space where experimentation thrives. Come with an idea, leave with something unexpected. We’re providing not just space, but an ecosystem—a place where independent thinkers can collide, collaborate, and create. If you’re the type of person who gets excited by blending disciplines in ways no one has seen before, this is your playground. WHAT’S INCLUDED: Full accommodation – In @anceu.coliving Support from the Rural Hackers – To back your concept unyieldingly, whether it fails or sparks a revolution. 500€ for you – To cover essentials, because creativity should never be limited by the rules of capitalism. Access to workspaces, tools, and guidance – Whatever you need to build, we’ll help you get there. This is not a retreat—it’s a launchpad. Come build, disrupt, and reimagine what’s possible. Does this resonate with you? Be brave an apply! Do you have a friend like this? Share! Applications on Bio.".

author: ruralhackers
caption: 🌾 Anceu Fest 2024 🎶 🗣️ {English below} O Anceu Fest 2024 foi máis que un simple festival: foi unha celebración da nosa forza colectiva e do vibrante espírito comunitario que nos une na Galicia rural. Este ano, a música foi tan diversa como a nosa comunidade, unindo melodías tradicionais galegas, flamenco, jazz e incluso un toque de ritmos do Norte de África. 👩‍💻 Dende @ruralhackers queremos dar un enorme agradecemento á Asociación de Veciños polo seu apoio, as artistas de @culturemoveseurope por crear un escenario tan máxico, ao equipo de @wppontevedra por unirse a nós e enriquecer a nosa comunidade, a @oitavenlife polas cuestións loxísticas e as personas que axudaron de manera voluntaria que traballaron para que todo funcionase á perfección. ❤️ Aquí tedes un pequeno adianto dos recordos que creamos xuntos. ¡Qué pasadaaaaa! 🎉 🗣 {English here} Anceu Fest 2024 was more than just a festival—it was a celebration of our collective strength and the vibrant community spirit that binds us in rural Galicia. This year, the music was as diverse as our community, bringing together traditional Galician melodies, flamenco, jazz, and even a touch of North Africa riffs. 💘 A huge thank you to the Neighbors’ Association for their incredible support, to the @culturemoveseurope artists for crafting such a magical stage, to the @wppontevedra team for joining us and enriching our community, and to the local volunteers who worked tirelessly to make everything run smoothly. ❤️ Here’s a sneak peak of the memories we have created together. What a blassssssstttttt! 🌟 🎥 Video by @just__wojtek 💘 #AnceuFest2024 #RuralCommunity #GalicianCulture #CommunitySpirit #RuralUnity #FestivalVibes #CultureMovesEurope #TogetherWeThrive".
